pairs.evidence: lib/db/pglite/mappers.ts:142 An unrecognised membership.kind is still decoded as the valid 'member' variant (with only a once-per-value console.warn at line 137), so a corrupt vocabulary cell becomes a healthy row. It is neither rejected nor quarantined, which is the silent third option row-mapping bans.

techniques.evidence: lib/db/pglite/mappers.ts:142 Unknown closed-vocabulary text is passed through as a member. The num() helper (internals.ts:167) similarly turns null/NaN into 0.

lib/db/pglite/internals.ts:252 The upsert builder pushes each value and derives its placeholder index in one motion. Table identifiers in accounting.ts are allowlisted (SAFE_IDENT plus KNOWN_TABLES, line 222).
lib/db/pglite/internals.ts:232 The set-shaped upsert is chunked by row count and by bind-parameter budget.
lib/db/pglite/accounting.test.ts:62 Engine tests run on a real PGlite fixture dir via the production open().
